# NGXSMK UI Kit

> Angular-first, MIT-licensed UI ecosystem: 258+ signals-native, zoneless
> standalone components with a universal design-token engine (CSS variables,
> SCSS, Tailwind, StyleX, Tokens Studio export). MIT licensed, no paid tiers.
> Current version: 2.0.0. Supports Angular 17.3 through 22.

Packages: `@ngxsmk/core` (components, one secondary entry point per component,
e.g. `@ngxsmk/core/button`), `@ngxsmk/theme` (design tokens + theme engine),
`@ngxsmk/cdk` (behavior primitives), `@ngxsmk/mcp` (MCP server for coding agents).

Usage rules for generated code:
- All components are standalone; import the class and add it to the `imports` array.
- APIs are signal-based: inputs are `input()` signals (bind with `[prop]`),
  outputs are `output()` (bind with `(event)`), `model()` inputs support `[(prop)]`.
- Style via `--ngxsmk-*` CSS custom properties, never by overriding internal classes.
- Import theme styles once: `@import '@ngxsmk/theme/css';` and toggle dark mode
  by adding the `dark` class to `<html>`.

- Website & docs: https://ngxsmk.github.io/ngxsmk-ui-kit
- Packages on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/org/ngxsmk

## Components

## NgxsmkAccordion

- Selector: `ngxsmk-accordion`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/accordion`
- Expandable section container.

Inputs:
- `[multiple]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[accordionDuration]`: number (default: `0.2`)
- `[accordionEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'ease-out'`)
- `[accordionAnimation]`: 'css' | 'motion' (default: `'css'`)

## NgxsmkAccordionItem

- Selector: `ngxsmk-accordion-item`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/accordion`

Inputs:
- `[label]`: string (required)
- `[value]`: string (default: `''`)
- `[disabled]`: boolean (default: `false`)

## NgxsmkAiChat

- Selector: `ngxsmk-ai-chat`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/ai-chat`

Inputs:
- `[messages]`: NgxsmkAiMessage[] (default: `[]`)
- `[models]`: string[] (default: `['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-2.5-pro', 'claude-3.5-sonnet']`)
- `[selectedModel]`: string (default: `'gemini-2.5-flash'`)
- `[suggestions]`: string[] (default: `[]`)
- `[isTyping]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[tokenCount]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[placeholder]`: string (default: `'Ask me anything...'`)

Outputs:
- `(sendMessage)`: emits `string`
- `(modelChanged)`: emits `string`

## NgxsmkAnimate

- Selector: `[ngxsmkAnimate]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Plays an enter animation on the host element once it is rendered. Supports two APIs: 1. **State API** — pass a full `NgxsmkMotionState` via `ngxsmkAnimate`. 2. **Param API** — pass individual signal inputs (`animateDuration`, `animateType`, etc.). These compose into a `NgxsmkMotionState` internally. When both are provided the state object takes precedence.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkAnimate]`: NgxsmkMotionState
- `[animateInitial]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[animateTarget]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[animateExit]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[animateType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' | 'inertia' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[animateDuration]`: number (default: `0.3`)
- `[animateDelay]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[animateEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'ease-out'`)
- `[animateStiffness]`: number
- `[animateDamping]`: number
- `[animateMass]`: number
- `[animateBounce]`: number
- `[animateVisualDuration]`: number
- `[animatePower]`: number
- `[animateTimeConstant]`: number

## NgxsmkDrag

- Selector: `[ngxsmkDrag]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Enables drag gestures on the host element using `motion`'s drag system. When `motion` is not installed, this directive is a no-op.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkDrag]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[dragAxis]`: 'x' | 'y' | 'both' (default: `'both'`)
- `[dragElastic]`: number (default: `0.2`)
- `[dragMomentum]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[dragSnapToOrigin]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[dragBounce]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[dragConstraints]`: {
    top?: number;
    left?: number;
    right?: number;
    bottom?: number;
  }
- `[dragSnapDuration]`: number (default: `0.3`)

Outputs:
- `(dragStarted)`: emits `void`
- `(dragging)`: emits `{ x: number; y: number }`
- `(dragEnded)`: emits `{ x: number; y: number }`

## NgxsmkHover

- Selector: `[ngxsmkHover]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Animates the host element on hover using `motion.hover()`. When `motion` is not installed, this directive is a no-op.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkHover]`: NgxsmkMotionState
- `[hoverScale]`: number (default: `1.05`)
- `[hoverOpacity]`: number (default: `1`)
- `[hoverRotate]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[hoverType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[hoverDuration]`: number (default: `0.2`)
- `[hoverEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'ease-out'`)
- `[hoverStiffness]`: number
- `[hoverDamping]`: number
- `[hoverMass]`: number

Outputs:
- `(hovered)`: emits `boolean`

## NgxsmkMarquee

- Selector: `[ngxsmkMarquee]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Creates a continuous scrolling marquee animation from the host element's content. The content is cloned to fill the viewport. When `motion` is installed, uses `motion.animate()` with `repeat: Infinity` for smooth hardware-accelerated scrolling. Falls back to CSS

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkMarquee]`: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' (default: `'horizontal'`)
- `[marqueeSpeed]`: number (default: `15`)
- `[marqueePauseOnHover]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[marqueeDirection]`: 'normal' | 'reverse' (default: `'normal'`)
- `[marqueeEasing]`: string | number[] (default: `'linear'`)
- `[marqueeRepeatType]`: 'loop' | 'reverse' | 'mirror' (default: `'loop'`)

## NgxsmkNumberTicker

- Selector: `[ngxsmkNumberTicker]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Animates the host element's text content from a start number to a target number. Uses `motion.animate()` when available for smooth easing and spring physics; falls back to `requestAnimationFrame`.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkNumberTicker]`: number (required)
- `[numberTickerFrom]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[numberTickerType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' | 'inertia' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[numberTickerDuration]`: number (default: `1`)
- `[numberTickerDelay]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[numberTickerStiffness]`: number
- `[numberTickerDamping]`: number
- `[numberTickerMass]`: number
- `[numberTickerBounce]`: number
- `[numberTickerVisualDuration]`: number
- `[numberTickerEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'easeOut'`)
- `[numberTickerFormat]`: Intl.NumberFormatOptions (default: `{}`)
- `[numberTickerPrefix]`: string (default: `''`)
- `[numberTickerSuffix]`: string (default: `''`)

## NgxsmkPresence

- Selector: `[ngxsmkPresence]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Structural directive that mounts its template and plays an enter animation, then plays an exit animation before detaching when the `show` input flips to `false`. Mirrors the host's presence so leave animations can complete. Supports two APIs: 1. **State API** — pass a full `NgxsmkMotionState` via `motion`. 2. **Param API** — pass individual signal inputs (`presenceDuration`, etc.).

Inputs:
- `[show]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[motion]`: NgxsmkMotionState
- `[presenceInitial]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[presenceAnimate]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[presenceExit]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[presenceType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' | 'inertia' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[presenceDuration]`: number (default: `0.2`)
- `[presenceDelay]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[presenceEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'ease-out'`)
- `[presenceStiffness]`: number
- `[presenceDamping]`: number
- `[presenceMass]`: number
- `[presenceBounce]`: number
- `[presenceVisualDuration]`: number
- `[presencePower]`: number
- `[presenceTimeConstant]`: number

Outputs:
- `(afterLeave)`: emits `void`

## NgxsmkPress

- Selector: `[ngxsmkPress]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Animates the host element on press (pointer down) using `motion.press()`. When `motion` is not installed, this directive is a no-op.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkPress]`: NgxsmkMotionState
- `[pressScale]`: number (default: `0.95`)
- `[pressOpacity]`: number (default: `0.8`)
- `[pressType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[pressDuration]`: number (default: `0.1`)
- `[pressEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'ease-out'`)
- `[pressStiffness]`: number
- `[pressDamping]`: number
- `[pressMass]`: number

Outputs:
- `(pressed)`: emits `boolean`

## NgxsmkScrollLinked

- Selector: `[ngxsmkScrollLinked]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Links animation progress to scroll position using `motion.scroll()`. The element's style properties are driven by scroll progress (0→1). When `motion` is not installed, this directive is a no-op.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkScrollLinked]`: Record<string, [string | number, string | number] | string | number> (required)
- `[scrollLinkedOffset]`: [string, string] (default: `['start end', 'end start']`)
- `[scrollLinkedAxis]`: 'x' | 'y' (default: `'y'`)
- `[scrollLinkedTarget]`: HTMLElement
- `[scrollLinkedContainer]`: HTMLElement

## NgxsmkScrollReveal

- Selector: `[ngxsmkScrollReveal]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Animates an element when it enters the viewport. When `motion` is installed, uses `motion.inView()` for detection and `motion.animate()` for the animation. Falls back to IntersectionObserver when motion is not installed.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkScrollReveal]`: NgxsmkMotionState
- `[scrollRevealInitial]`: Record<string, string | number> (default: `{
    opacity: 0,
    y: 24,
  }`)
- `[scrollRevealAnimate]`: Record<string, string | number> (default: `{
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
  }`)
- `[scrollRevealExit]`: Record<string, string | number>
- `[scrollRevealType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' | 'inertia' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[scrollRevealDuration]`: number (default: `0.6`)
- `[scrollRevealDelay]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[scrollRevealEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'ease-out'`)
- `[scrollRevealStiffness]`: number
- `[scrollRevealDamping]`: number
- `[scrollRevealMass]`: number
- `[scrollRevealBounce]`: number
- `[scrollRevealVisualDuration]`: number
- `[scrollRevealMargin]`: string (default: `'0px'`)
- `[scrollRevealAmount]`: 'some' | 'all' | number (default: `'some'`)
- `[scrollRevealOnce]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[scrollRevealDirection]`: 'enter' | 'exit' (default: `'enter'`)

Outputs:
- `(scrolled)`: emits `boolean`

## NgxsmkTextReveal

- Selector: `[ngxsmkTextReveal]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Splits the host element's text content into words or letters and staggers an animation on each unit. Replaces the element's text content, so the host should contain only a text node.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkTextReveal]`: NgxsmkMotionState | 'word' | 'letter' (default: `'word'`)
- `[textRevealMode]`: 'word' | 'letter' (default: `'word'`)
- `[textRevealStagger]`: number (default: `0.05`)
- `[textRevealDuration]`: number (default: `0.4`)
- `[textRevealInitial]`: Record<string, string | number> (default: `{
    opacity: 0,
    y: 8,
  }`)
- `[textRevealAnimate]`: Record<string, string | number> (default: `{
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
  }`)
- `[textRevealType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' | 'inertia' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[textRevealStiffness]`: number
- `[textRevealDamping]`: number
- `[textRevealMass]`: number
- `[textRevealEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)'`)

## NgxsmkTiltCard

- Selector: `[ngxsmkTiltCard]`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/animation`
- Applies a 3D tilt transform to the host element based on the pointer position. The tilt angle is clamped by `maxTilt` and scales down when the pointer moves away from the center. When `motion` is installed, uses `motion.hover()` for gesture detection (filters touch emulation) and `motion.animate()` for smooth transitions. Falls back to manual pointermove/pointerleave when motion is not installed.

Inputs:
- `[ngxsmkTiltCard]`: number (default: `15`)
- `[tiltCardScale]`: number (default: `1.02`)
- `[tiltCardPerspective]`: number (default: `1000`)
- `[tiltCardType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[tiltCardTransition]`: number (default: `400`)
- `[tiltCardStiffness]`: number
- `[tiltCardDamping]`: number
- `[tiltCardMass]`: number

## NgxsmkExpandingArrowButton

- Selector: `ngxsmk-expanding-arrow-button`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/expanding-arrow-button`
- An accent-tile button that expands into a dotted-arrow trail on hover or focus. The accent area grows from a small square to fill the width, revealing a trail of chevron dots that fade in with staggered delay. When `motion` is installed, uses `motion.animate()` with `stagger()` for the dot reveal. Falls back to CSS transitions when motion is not installed.

Inputs:
- `[disabled]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[accentBg]`: string (default: `'var(--ngxsmk-color-primary, #18181b)'`)
- `[accentColor]`: string (default: `'var(--ngxsmk-color-on-primary, #fafafa)'`)
- `[eabAnimation]`: 'css' | 'motion' (default: `'css'`)
- `[eabDuration]`: number (default: `0.32`)
- `[eabEase]`: string | number[] (default: `'cubic-bezier(0.36, 0, 0.66, -0.56)'`)
- `[eabType]`: 'tween' | 'spring' (default: `'tween'`)
- `[eabStiffness]`: number
- `[eabDamping]`: number

- `[showStatusIcon]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[fullWidth]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[loading]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[floatingLabel]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[addons]`: InputGroupAddon[] (default: `[]`)
- `[inputType]`: InputGroupInputType | 'password' (default: `'text'`)
- `[(value)]`: string (default: `''`)
- `[id]`: unknown (default: `ngxsmkUniqueId('ngxsmk-input-group')`)
- `[(ariaInvalid)]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[(ariaDescribedby)]`: string | null (default: `null`)

Outputs:
- `(focused)`: emits `void`
- `(blurred)`: emits `void`
- `(cleared)`: emits `void`
- `(valueChanged)`: emits `string`
- `(validationChanged)`: emits `{ status: ValidationStatus; message: string }`

## NgxsmkMeter

- Selector: `ngxsmk-meter`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/meter`
- Semantic meter for a scalar measurement within a known range (disk usage, score, capacity) — distinct from `progress`, which reports task completion. Colour follows the `low`/`high`/`optimum` thresholds like the native `<meter>` element. Pure `computed` output; no effects, SSR-safe.

Inputs:
- `[value]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[min]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[max]`: number (default: `100`)
- `[low]`: number | null (default: `null`)
- `[high]`: number | null (default: `null`)
- `[optimum]`: number | null (default: `null`)
- `[size]`: NgxsmkMeterSize (default: `'md'`)
- `[label]`: string (default: `''`)
- `[ariaLabel]`: string (default: `'Meter'`)
- `[showValue]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[format]`: (value: number, max: number) => string

## NgxsmkMorphModal

- Content panel for the morph modal. Renders into the document body via a portal and applies clip-path animation. When `motion` is installed, uses `motion.animate()` for the clip-path unfold. Falls back to CSS transitions when motion is not installed.

- `[morphModalDamping]`: number

## NgxsmkPopover

- Selector: `ngxsmk-popover`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/popover`
- Click-triggered popover anchored to its trigger. Positioning is done entirely in CSS from `data-placement`/`data-align` — there are **no** `getBoundingClientRect` reads, scroll listeners, or portals — so it never thrashes layout and renders identically under SSR. Outside-click and Escape close it; focus is trapped and restored to the trigger.

Inputs:
- `[(open)]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[placement]`: NgxsmkPopoverPlacement (default: `'bottom'`)
- `[align]`: NgxsmkPopoverAlign (default: `'center'`)
- `[offset]`: number (default: `8`)
- `[disabled]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[closeOnOutsideClick]`: boolean (default: `true`)

Outputs:
- `(opened)`: emits `void`
- `(closed)`: emits `void`

## NgxsmkScheduler

- Selector: `ngxsmk-scheduler`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/scheduler`

Inputs:
- `[(events)]`: SchedulerEvent[] (required)
- `[view]`: ViewType (default: `'timeGridWeek'`)
- `[date]`: Date (default: `new Date()`)
- `[resources]`: SchedulerResource[] (default: `[]`)
- `[slotDuration]`: number (default: `30`)
- `[snapDuration]`: number (default: `15`)
- `[visibleHours]`: [number, number] (default: `[0, 24]`)
- `[firstDayOfWeek]`: number (default: `1`)
- `[locale]`: string (default: `'en-US'`)
- `[rtl]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[density]`: Density (default: `'comfortable'`)
- `[showAllDay]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[showWeekends]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[showCurrentTime]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[editable]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[selectable]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[draggable]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[resizable]`: boolean (default: `true`)
- `[plugins]`: SchedulerPlugin[] (default: `[]`)

Outputs:
- `(eventClick)`: emits `SchedulerEvent`
- `(eventDoubleClick)`: emits `SchedulerEvent`
- `(eventContextMenu)`: emits `{
    event: SchedulerEvent;
    position: { x: number; y: number };
  }`
- `(eventDrop)`: emits `SchedulerMove`
- `(eventResize)`: emits `SchedulerResize`
- `(eventCreate)`: emits `SchedulerCreate`
- `(viewChange)`: emits `{ view: ViewType; start: Date; end: Date }`
- `(dateChange)`: emits `Date`
- `(prevWeek)`: emits `void`
- `(nextWeek)`: emits `void`
- `(todayClick)`: emits `void`

## NgxsmkSelect

- Selector: `ngxsmk-select`
- Import from: `@ngxsmk/core/select`
- Themed single-select dropdown. A custom trigger + popup listbox (not a native `<select>`), so it themes consistently across browsers like the rest of the control family and matches `ngxsmk-input`'s visual language exactly. Pairs with `ngxsmk-form-field` for label, hint, and error wiring via the same `id` / `ariaInvalid` / `ariaDescribedby` hooks `ngxsmk-input` exposes.

Inputs:
- `[options]`: NgxsmkSelectOption[] (required)
- `[(value)]`: string (default: `''`)
- `[placeholder]`: string (default: `''`)
- `[disabled]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[emptyLabel]`: string (default: `'No options'`)
- `[id]`: unknown (default: `ngxsmkUniqueId('ngxsmk-select')`)
- `[ariaLabelledby]`: string | null (default: `null`)
- `[(ariaInvalid)]`: boolean (default: `false`)
- `[(ariaDescribedby)]`: string | null (default: `null`)

Outputs:
- `(changed)`: emits `string`

- `[node]`: NgxsmkTreeNode (required)
- `[level]`: number (default: `0`)
- `[selectable]`: 'none' | 'single' | 'multi' (default: `'none'`)

Outputs:
- `(nodeSelected)`: emits `NgxsmkTreeNode`
- `(nodeExpanded)`: emits `NgxsmkTreeNode`
- `(nodeCollapsed)`: emits `NgxsmkTreeNode`
